div.p: This municipality in the middle eastern suburbs of Melbourne was created in 1994 by combining the former cities of Box Hill and Nunawading. Whitehorse Road traverses the city from east to west. It took its name from Patrick Trainor's Whitehorse Hotel which was built in 1853 on the corner of Elgar and Whitehorse roads.
